statements.status_notes: CVE-2015-5237 is an integer overflow in MessageLite serialization when a message exceeds 2 GiB. Protobuf 3.21.12 (the upstream version in this Debian source package) uses ByteSizeLong() and rejects serialization when ByteSizeLong() exceeds INT_MAX before allocating buffers (see src/google/protobuf/message_lite.cc in protocolbuffers/protobuf v3.21.12). Debian security tracking still lists the CVE as unfixed, but the shipped 3.21.12 sources include the upstream mitigation from protobuf 3.4.0+.
